items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: This guy, Bubbles Whitman, who was a Black comedian in shows then... Actually, he was a movie actor... he was quite active in the movies, one of the most prominent Black actors then.

ctx.x: V-disks, yeah, for the men overseas, for their entertainment. And we got a commission to do these things, and I think we did it for about three or four weeks. Every Monday, I think when we were off at the club, we would go into Hollywood at NBC Studios, and do these shows... This guy, Bubbles Whitman, who was a Black comedian in shows then... Actually, he was a movie actor, and he had been in a number of pictures where Black people were used then... Most of the times he was either in a picture, something of the…
He MC'ed these shows, and they would have.... I remember one of the shows that was the Billy Eckstine band with Sarah
